toolsBlock.text: I'm not the designer or the developer. I'm the project manager who clears the path so they can do their best work. On time, on budget, without the chaos.

principles.title: The method fits the job
principles.text: No single methodology. I've run yearly launch programmes and sprint-based product work, and I pick whatever gets the team to done.

principles.title: I clear the path
principles.text: Designers and developers do their best work when decisions, sign-offs and briefs are sorted before they start. Sorting them is my job.

principles.title: Plan the work, then work the plan
principles.text: Every project I run starts with an agreed scope and a plan, and changes go through change control, whether it runs Waterfall, Agile or a mix of both. On the Hay.chat website that meant 32 scoped work packages, each checked against its brief before it shipped.

principles.title: AI as the build team
principles.text: I direct Claude Code as the build team on the Hay.chat website. I set the direction, write the briefs, review the output and decide what ships. That's 40 recorded reviews so far.
